## What

One or two sentences.

## Why

Link the to-do, issue or idea this PR belongs to.

## Checklist

- [ ] One topic only
- [ ] Docs updated? (or not needed)
- [ ] Log entry added to `docs/log.md`?
- [ ] `docs/todo.md` checkboxes updated?
- [ ] Anything undecided is marked "proposal"
- [ ] No secrets in the diff
